record_layout: 306 feature bytes, 32 label bytes, 32 mask bytes, 3 diagnostic bytes that are never inputs

fields.name: my_hand
fields.meaning: cards I hold, one bit per card in suit-major rank-minor order

fields.name: played_by_me
fields.meaning: cards I have played and still remember playing

fields.name: played_by_left
fields.meaning: cards my left-hand opponent played, as far as I remember them

fields.name: played_by_right
fields.meaning: cards my right-hand opponent played, as far as I remember them

fields.name: played_present
fields.meaning: 1 when the trick history is remembered at all

fields.name: current_trick
fields.meaning: cards face up in the trick being played; never forgotten

fields.name: trick_leader
fields.meaning: who led the current trick, relative: me, left, right

fields.name: my_discard
fields.meaning: the two cards I buried, when I am the declarer and remember them

fields.name: my_discard_present
fields.meaning: 1 when the discard above is mine and known

fields.name: pushed_on
fields.meaning: the two cards I pushed on in a Schieberamsch

fields.name: pushed_to_skat
fields.meaning: 1 when I was rearhand, so what I pushed became the skat and I know it

fields.name: received
fields.meaning: the two cards handed to me, which my right-hand neighbour no longer has

fields.name: received_from_skat
fields.meaning: 1 when I was forehand, so what I received was the dealt skat and says nothing

fields.name: schieben_present
fields.meaning: 1 in a Ramsch whose Schieben this seat remembers

fields.name: contract
fields.meaning: diamonds, hearts, spades, clubs, grand, null, ramsch

fields.name: declarer
fields.meaning: who is playing alone, relative: me, left, right, nobody -- the last is a Ramsch

fields.name: bid_value
fields.meaning: the winning bid divided by 100

fields.name: bids_by_seat
fields.meaning: the highest bid each seat made, relative, divided by 100

fields.name: bidding_present
fields.meaning: 1 when the auction is remembered; the first thing a club player drops

fields.name: contra_level
fields.meaning: Kontra said, and Re said -- a defender doubling has claimed something

fields.name: contra_seat
fields.meaning: who said Kontra, relative: me, left, right

fields.name: void_left
fields.meaning: classes my left-hand opponent has shown out of: trump, then four suits

fields.name: void_right
fields.meaning: the same for my right-hand opponent

fields.name: trumps_out
fields.meaning: trumps still unaccounted for, divided by 11 -- the count a player keeps

fields.name: trumps_mine
fields.meaning: trumps in my own hand, divided by 11

fields.name: jacks_out
fields.meaning: one bit per jack still unseen, clubs to diamonds -- counted hardest of all

fields.name: counts_present
fields.meaning: 1 when the trump and jack counters are being kept

fields.name: cards_left
fields.meaning: cards still held by me, left and right, each divided by 10

fields.name: trick_number
fields.meaning: tricks completed, divided by 10
